source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: When the unit this Shaman leads is chosen to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or to fight in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), the Shaman can use this ability. Pick a Bodyguard model in the unit and destroy it. Through phase end, add D3 to both Attacks and Strength for the Shaman’s equipped Psychic weapons.
